# Bayesian Statistics {#sec-ch-10-bayesian}

<!-- page-provenance:start -->
::: {.page-provenance}
*R. Heller · Date: 2026-05-11 · Last changed: 2026-10-30*
:::
<!-- page-provenance:end -->

Posterior inference via `brms` and Stan: priors, hierarchical models, posterior predictive checks, leave-one-out cross-validation, and Bayes factors. The chapter is opinionated: it treats Bayesian inference as a default, not an alternative.

This chapter contains **35 method pages** and **2 labs**. If you are not sure which method to read, return to [Chapter 0](#sec-find-your-method) and follow the decision tree to the right node.
